name: round 2: The button
tests: src/connect-agent.mjs loads as a module with no error and defines the custom element connect-agent
the module builds its links with round 1's core: loading it loads /src/harnesses.mjs
the element's markup is in its light DOM or its open shadow root
the button is a <button> data-testid="connect-button" reading "Connect your agent" by default, or the label attribute
the button is disabled with no prompt, an empty prompt or a whitespace-only one, and enabled with a real one
changing the label attribute changes the button's text, and removing it brings back "Connect your agent"
changing the prompt attribute updates the element: its disabled state, then the link it opens
clicking the button opens the picker: data-testid="picker", not shown before, role="dialog", aria-modal="true", labelled
the picker shows the seven agents in catalogue order, each a <button> data-testid="agent-<id>" showing its name
the close control data-testid="picker-close" closes the picker, and the focus returns to the button
choosing Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Le Chat or Cursor closes the picker and calls window.open(link, "_blank") once, with linkFor's value
choosing Claude Code or Codex CLI closes the picker, copies the command with navigator.clipboard.writeText, and a role="status" notice says it was copied and to paste it in a terminal
an agent whose link would be over 8,000 characters is shown with aria-disabled="true" and the reason, and choosing it does nothing
the limit is measured on the encoded link: exactly 8,000 characters can be chosen, 8,001 cannot, and commands never reach it
opening the picker moves the focus to the first agent, Claude, whether it is opened by a click or from the keyboard
ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the focus from agent to agent, wrapping at both ends
Enter and Space on a focused agent choose it, once, then the picker closes and the focus returns to the button
Escape closes the picker without choosing, and the focus returns to the button
a click outside the picker closes it without choosing an agent
two <connect-agent> on one page work independently: each has its own picker, prompt, notice and ARIA references
the button loads nothing but the local server: no request to another host while it is used
the button has no dependency: package.json declares none and the page loads nothing from node_modules
demo/index.html, which npm run demo serves, shows a <connect-agent> with a prompt whose button opens the picker
